name: Godfist Subdomain
body:
Godfist is a subdomain of strength and war. For easy reference, all appropriate powers and spells are listed here.

Granted Powers
Dazing Touch (Sp)

At 1st level, you can cause a living creature to become dazed for 1 round as a melee touch attack. Creatures with more Hit Dice than your warpriest level are unaffected. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Harness Spirit: Choose three unchained monk ki powers as a monk of your warpriest level. You gain those powers and can spend fervor to use them. You can also use fervor 2 additional times per day.
Domain Spells: 1st—magic weapon; 2nd—vine strike*; 3rd—greater magic weapon; 4th—blood crow strike*; 5th—forceful strike; 6th—forceful hand; 7th—ethereal jaunt; 8th—death clutch; 9th—fiery body

* You can treat your sacred weapon as your unarmed strike with this spell.

S-Class Characters: Warpriests. Copyright 2024, Samurai Sheepdog. Author: Kevin Glusing
